name: National Scholarship Portal (NSP)
department: Ministry of Electronics & IT / Department of School Education & Literacy
summary: Single window portal bringing together 140+ central and state scholarship schemes for students from Class 1 to PhD.
eligibility: Varies by individual scheme — generally Indian citizens enrolled in a recognised institution
Family income ceilings, academic performance thresholds, and category reservations (SC/ST/OBC/EWS/minority/girls/PwBD) differ per scheme
documents: Caste certificate, where the scheme requires it
fee: Free — no application fee for any NSP scheme
process: Complete One Time Registration (OTR) on scholarships.gov.in with Aadhaar, mobile number, and face authentication
Log in and browse schemes you're eligible for
Fill the scheme-specific application form and upload supporting documents
Submit — the application routes to your institution for verification
After institutional and state-level verification, the scholarship amount is disbursed via Direct Benefit Transfer
source: Department of School Education & Literacy, Ministry of Education

faq.question: Do I need to register separately for each scholarship?
faq.answer: No — you complete One Time Registration (OTR) once on NSP, then apply to any number of eligible schemes each year using the same OTR ID.

faq.question: How long does disbursal take after applying?
faq.answer: It depends on institutional and state verification timelines, which vary widely by scheme; check your application status on the NSP dashboard for the current stage.
